She holds chopsticks and points towards the camera with a bright smile. (2) Close-up shots of raw, thick cuts of pork belly and neck meat being placed on a black ribbed grill. Metal tongs are visible flipping the meat as steam rises. Garlic cloves are scattered in the background on the grill surface. (3) The woman is seen eating a large piece of grilled meat, showing an expression of extreme satisfaction. A male server wearing a black shirt and glasses stands nearby, using a copper-colored exhaust pipe and tongs to grill meat for her. (4) Detailed close-ups of various pork cuts including 'Meihua' (pork neck) and 'Shuangjiang' (marbled pork). A pair of metal scissors cuts the cooked meat into small, bite-sized cubes. A bowl of special green onion and chili sauce is shown being dipped into. (5) The woman holds up a glass of clear cocktail with green leaves, then shows the grilled pork skin being dipped in a brown sauce and yellow powder. (6) The woman speaks directly to the camera in a closer shot, looking more serious and slightly emotional, before concluding with a smile. The lighting is bright and consistent throughout.
